name: minecart-rom-base
description: Base world for the Minecart ROM fixture: a floating note-block driven minecart popper over the void, exported from the source save with players, logs and test residue removed.

artifact.url_note: commit-pinned immutable URL; verified by sha256, no release required

datapack_features.notes: minecart_improvements must stay disabled: the machine relies on the classic minecart behaviour, and the stack only forms when the experiment is off.

mods.name: carpet
mods.notes: Carpet provides the real fake player (`/player <name> spawn`, `use`, `look`, `turn`, `tick`).

mods.name: wavecarpet
mods.notes: The source save carries wavecarpet_pistonbolt.dat, but the calibration reproduced the full machine cycle with only Fabric API + Carpet. Not needed for the fixture.

mods.name: carpet-tis-addition
mods.notes: Present in the source client; not needed by the fixture.

mods.name: mc-agent-interface-mod
mods.notes: server vantage: real ServerLevel.entityTickList via SNAPSHOT; the fixture binds its ready evidence to it

world.hash: sorted relative path + file sha256, session.lock excluded; see runner/export_world.py

removed: all saved entities: 3 leftover falling minecraft:item stacks at y=-113/-108/-95
